ref_text: HOW COMES IT THAT WHILE THE FIRST BEATITUDE PROMISES THE KINGDOM OF HEAVEN TO THE POOR OF HEART THE SECOND BEATITUDE PROMISES ALSO TO THE MEEK THAT THEY SHALL POSSESS THE LAND
text: How comes it that while the first Battitude promises the kingdom of heaven to the poor of heart, the second Battitude promises also to the meek that they shall possess the land?
